name: Gilded Dune Orchestra
description: Desert dunes transformed into musical instruments – golden sand flutes, drums, and violins that play wind‑driven melodies.
prompt: Vast desert dunes sculpted into a grand orchestra of golden sand instruments – flutes, drums, and violins, each resonating with wind-blown melodies, under a deep violet twilight sky, epic scale, photorealistic, no text.
caption: Let the golden dunes conduct a symphony that only the desert wind can hear.
